items.period: Shang oracle-bone script style; modern vector redraw based on cited character references
items.caption: A modern redraw labeled Shang oracle style. The article describes early 文 forms as human-shaped, with chest marks varying or absent; the mark’s meaning is disputed.
items.alt: Modern vector rendering labeled 文 in Shang oracle script style.
items.selection_reason: Shows the early graph category relevant to the reported human-shaped outline and variable chest marking, while allowing the caption to qualify the disputed interpretation.
items.rights: Commons page states the SVG representation is public domain and releases rights generated in making it; this is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

items.period: Bronze-script style; modern vector redraw, not a dated artifact specimen
items.caption: A modern bronze-script-style redraw. Chest marks are discussed as variable in early forms, but whether they represent tattoos or another feature is unresolved.
items.alt: Modern vector rendering labeled 文 in bronze script style.
items.selection_reason: Pairs with the oracle-style redraw to represent the article’s reported early graphic variation and the continuing uncertainty about chest marks.
items.rights: Commons page states the SVG representation is public domain and releases rights generated in making it; this is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

items.period: Seal-script style as transmitted in Shuowen; modern vector redraw
items.caption: A modern redraw of the Shuowen seal-script form, the form Xu Shen interprets as crossed markings; that Han explanation does not by itself establish the Shang graph’s original referent.
items.alt: Modern vector rendering labeled 文 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Shows the later lexicographic form associated with Xu Shen’s historical interpretation, distinct from claims about the Shang graph’s origin.
items.rights: Commons page states the SVG representation is public domain and releases rights generated in making it; this is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: Selected glyph files are modern redraws based on external character-reference sources, not photographs or direct reproductions of dated oracle bones or bronzes; treat their script labels and shape as source descriptions pending pixel and underlying-record review.
The visual evidence does not settle whether chest marks depict tattoos, another body marking, or a different feature; the ‘great’ interpretation is a separate semantic proposal.
